    void
    WriteRecordingOverride.writeRecordingOverridesToFile(String scope, SquareControlParams params, List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries, int currentIndex)
    Applies and writes overrides for the selected scope: "Recording" – update only the current recording "Experiment" – update all recordings in the same experiment "Project" – update every recording in the viewer Overrides are written non-destructively: existing rows for the same (experimentName, recordingName) pair are replaced; all other entries are preserved.
